note: Carried by absorbs/grade_le_mix and decay_cost, and by Secured.honored, which takes a common strip for the finitely many words (limited_lengths, staple) and passes through bankCost and matrix_cover. Differences: the order range is stated as r <= j-2 rather than as the two cases, the decay is a weighted ell^1 Width bound rather than a pointwise contour-shift estimate, and the principal alias is covered inside the alias sum, with no separate statement for it.

lemma absorbs (l : Site L) (t r : ℕ) : grade l ^ t * decay (r+t) l ≤ decay r l := by
  rw [Nat.add_comm,decay_add, ← mul_assoc]
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (decay_pos _ r).le).trans (le_of_eq (one_mul _))
  unfold decay
  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one (pow_pos (mix_pos l) _)]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (grade_pos l).le (grade_le_mix l) t

proof_context.conclusion: grade l <= mix l, i.e. 1+|z| <= prod_a(1+|z_a|), hence grade^t * decay(r+t) <= decay r.

lemma honored [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (h : Secured f) (hj : 4≤j) (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ σ C : ℝ, 0<σ ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ (P : Flight j t) (u : List Axis), u.length ≤ j-2 →
      (advanceC P.L (meshBook f e [] P) u).strip σ (C/(P.L.val:ℝ)^(e+u.length)) := by
  letI : Fintype {l : List Axis // l.length≤j-2} := (limited_lengths (j-2)).fintype
  obtain ⟨σ,C,hp,hC,H⟩ := staple (κ:={l : List Axis // l.length≤j-2})
    (fun l σ C => ∀ P, (meshBook f e l.val P).strip σ (C/(P.L.val:ℝ)^(e+l.val.length)))
    (fun l => bankCost h hj e l.property) (fun l _ _ _ _ hv hσ hp hC P a b =>
        (hv P a b).mono hσ (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC (by positivity)))
  exact ⟨σ,C,hp,hC,fun P u hu => by rw [traverse h hj e hu]; exact H ⟨u,hu⟩ _⟩

proof_context.conclusion: One strip width and one constant serve all difference words of length <= j-2 (finitely many, by limited_lengths and staple), and the r-th fine-difference kernels have exponentially decaying coefficients with weight C/L^{e+r}.

lemma matrix_cover [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (h : Pay w f) {η : ℝ} (hp : 0 < η)
    (hh : ∀ i (p : Momentum), p∈realCube η → ∀ x, p+reciprocal x ∈ realCube η → f i (p+reciprocal x)=f i p) :
    ∃ σ C : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ i, (record (f i)).strip σ (C*w i) := by
  obtain ⟨σ,C,he,hc,h⟩ := tapes_sound h.stapleMat hp (fun i p hg x hx => by
    exact congr_fun (congr_fun (hh _ p hg x hx) _) _)
  exact ⟨σ,C,he,hc,fun i a b => h (i,a,b)⟩

proof_context.conclusion: A strip-bounded periodic symbol family has kernels with exponential Width bounds C*w_i, which is the contour-shift step.
